task: Check, lint or test a change to bstd (crates/blaze-std) in the cargo dev loop
do: uv run --frozen python harness/v2/bstd_cargo.py '{"command": "check"}' (also "clippy", "test", "write"; "filter" narrows test). It writes crates/zz-bstd-shim, a copy with bstd's blaze-only syntax taken out, and runs cargo on the package blaze-std-shim with the pinned nightly. Set CARGO_TARGET_DIR. Edit crates/blaze-std, never the copy; keep crates/zz-bstd-shim in .git/info/exclude and never commit the Cargo.lock line cargo adds. Three tests fail in the copy on main too (tests::explicit::a_worlds_limits_are_the_ones_its_maker_said, tests::paths::a_path_never_escapes_its_directory, video::videotoolbox's encode test), and tests::own and tests::cell are left out: compare with that baseline. A green run is about bstd under rustc; blaze check and blaze test of bstd are still the proof.
why: cargo +nightly check -p blaze-std ends in 10 errors on main (contract clauses, where const, core::reflect), so a bstd change could not be compiled at all in the dev loop (annoyances A10, fallible-1).
